mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for Hometelligent Inc. deck lighting installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our deck lighting installation process typically begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision and assess your deck. Next, we develop a customized lighting plan and provide a detailed estimate. Upon approval, our team schedules the installation, ensuring proper wiring, fixture placement, and electrical connections. Finally, we conduct a thorough test to confirm everything is working correctly and provide guidance on operation. We prioritize a seamless process from planning to completion.
